title: SnapshotAdapter
responsibility: Exports committed source into an isolated snapshot and reports changes before cleanup.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.root
inputs.description: Git repository containing the requested commit.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.commit
inputs.description: Commit or Git reference to export.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create.outputs
inputs.description: Paths where generated output may appear without drift.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link.root
inputs.description: Checkout providing an explicitly shared path.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link.path
inputs.description: Path joined to the checkout and snapshot for sharing.

inputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.artifact.path
inputs.description: Path resolved within the snapshot to measure.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.create
outputs.description: An isolated snapshot of the resolved committed tree.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.link
outputs.description: Whether an existing path was shared into the snapshot.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.misdeclared
outputs.description: Output declarations that cover committed source files.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.drift
outputs.description: Committed or shared paths changed and undeclared paths added.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.artifact
outputs.type: Promise<{ bytes: number; sha256: string } | undefined>
outputs.description: Artifact byte count and SHA-256, or undefined when unavailable.

outputs.name: SnapshotAdapter.remove
outputs.description: Completion after the snapshot and its inventory are removed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An invalid commit or failed Git and filesystem operation stops snapshot creation or use.

test.title: create initialized exports the committed source and cleans up failed creation
link initialized shares an existing path only once
misdeclared initialized rejects outputs covering tracked source
drift initialized detects changed source and undeclared additions
artifact initialized measures files inside the snapshot
remove initialized clears the exported snapshot and inventory
